name: werkstoff
description: My personal Claude Code plugin workshop.

plugins.name: befund
plugins.description: Makes a codebase describe its own health, with every finding tied to file:line evidence, and edits source only behind an authorization recorded on disk.

plugins.name: zeugnis
plugins.description: Audits code that looks right and is not, and counts a finding only after an independent pass has re-checked it.

plugins.name: zirkel
plugins.description: Makes sure a complex or ambiguous task is clarified, explored and decomposed before anyone starts executing it.

plugins.name: cupertino
plugins.description: A design and craft discipline rooted in Steve Jobs' documented decisions, run as a fixed lifecycle of stages from experience to ship, not a menu of design techniques.

plugins.name: andon
plugins.description: Hardens a repository stage by stage, proving each handoff between stages and halting rather than advancing past one it cannot prove.

plugins.name: cli-scaffold
plugins.description: Generates a production-grade command-line application in one of 12 languages, built against one five-pillar architecture doctrine and checked against it before you see it.

plugins.name: passung
plugins.description: Finds a convention your codebase follows two or more valid ways, picks the one that should become canon, and aligns every divergent site to it with a provable equivalence check.

plugins.name: takt
plugins.description: Refuses an edit or dispatch that runs ahead of a step the repository said must come first.

plugins.name: lehre
plugins.description: Researches a code style, pattern and architecture doctrine, then denies the write that would violate it.

plugins.name: nacharbeit
plugins.description: Reviews a Claude Code plugin against the official Anthropic standard, then reworks the mechanical and local-rewrite share of what falls short.

plugins.name: matrize
plugins.description: Derives a design system once from reference exemplars you admire, names every element, and emits it to any target.

plugins.name: arbeitsplan
plugins.description: Turns a described change into a budgeted workflow, builds it several independent ways at once, and lands exactly one result.
